query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.orderNumber,
  s.saleDate,
  s.channel,
  s.totalAmount,
  COUNT(si.id) as itemCount
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN saleItems si ON s.id = si.saleId
WHERE s.id IN (22290008, 23340003, 34530041, 34530046, 34530078, 34530084, 34530101, 34530104, 34530133, 35040005, 36330007, 36810035)
GROUP BY s.id
ORDER BY s.id
